newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK CBANK ONE-DAY REPO RATE UP TO 16.55 PCT.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK CBANK ONE-DAY REPO RATE UP TO 16.55 PCT.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Monday said the average rate at its one-day securities repurchase tender was 16.55 percent, up from 15.99 percent on January 15.
The NBS added that it had allocated funds totalling 1.0 billion crowns, the full fixed amount it had offered, through the tender.
The maximum bid in the tender was 17.5 percent, while the minimum bid rate was 15.84 percent, it added.
The NBS said it had received 1.99 billion crowns worth of bids.
According to official NBS figures, the banking sector is in a liquidity surplus, with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 102.2 percent as of Friday.
